comments.author: @spookydarlin
comments.text: I liked the video, just there is one problem. It may seem like America is invincible, but that’s exactly what the Roman Empire thought. If you told someone from the Roman empire that their empire would collapse in the next 100 years, they would laugh in your face. The same thing that happened to them is happening right now. During the Roman Empire, some people realized that they could just paint small wooden coins silver, and then use them as a cheat code so they could get anything they wanted. Sound familiar? Also, the hyperinflation caused by that made it so that the country got weaker, making it easier for the barbarians to break through. So basically what I’m saying is that the threat may not be from outside, it could be from within.
